title: Mizzen network lock
description: `network.lock.json`: a pinned copy of the network file and of each public project's page list, with hashes. It holds no timestamp.

source.description: Where the network file was read from, as the config writes it.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the network file's bytes.

projects.description: Every project of the file, in file order.

path.description: The page's URL below the project's base, such as `/guide/`.

sha256.description: Hash of the page's rendered body in the project's manifest.

previous.description: The hash before the latest update that changed it; cleared by `mizzen network update --accept`.

search.description: Folder of the project's search index below its path.

manifest.description: The project's page list as fetched. Present for public projects only.
